title: Source hyper-Ext sequence with a module as target
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $K\in D(A)$ be an object of the ordinary derived category of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $N$ be an $A$-module, and let $u\in\mathbf Z$ satisfy $H^a(K)=0$ for every $a>u$. Here $H^a$ denotes standard derived cohomology [def-weil-derived-category-cohomology-functor], $N[0]$ is the complex concentrated in degree zero, and $R\operatorname{Hom}_A$ is the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-object site with only the identity covering and coefficient ring $A$. There is an $A$-linear spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence]
$$E_2^{i,j}=\operatorname{Ext}^i_A(H^{-j}(K),N)\quad\Longrightarrow\quad H^{i+j}(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,N[0])),$$
where for $i\geq0$ the Ext group is computed in the abelian category of $A$-modules [def-pc-ext], and $E_2^{i,j}=0$ for $i<0$. The differential $d_s$ has bidegree $(s,1-s)$; $E_{s+1}^{i,j}$ is the kernel of the outgoing differential modulo the image of the incoming differential. Every page is zero outside $i\geq0$, $j\geq-u$, and every fixed bidegree eventually stabilizes to $E_\infty^{i,j}$. For every integer $t$, the abutment $H^t(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,N[0]))$ has a finite exhaustive separated filtration by $A$-submodules [def-sp-filtration] whose successive quotients are the $E_\infty^{t-j,j}$ with $-u\leq j\leq t$; if this interval is empty the abutment is zero. No Noetherian or finite-generation hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0G20, remark-spectral-sequences-ext-variant: renumbered E2 sequence, with M=K and second argument N[0]. Support i>=0, j>=-u and finite filtration are the shifted first-quadrant specialization of its bounded convergence assertion.

proof.text: Choose a representative $M^\bullet$ of $K$ with $M^a=0$ for $a>u$, using the equivalence between cohomological and representative upper bounds in [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Its cohomology is $H^a(K)$. Concretely, for any representative $C^\bullet$, replace it by $\tau_{\leq u}C^\bullet$: the inclusion induces the identity on cohomology in degrees at most $u$ and an isomorphism $0\to H^a(C)=0$ above $u$.

Apply [lem-trf-source-hom-double-complex-model] to the representative $M^\bullet$ of step 1 and to $N$. Choose its nonnegative injective resolution $I^\bullet$ and signed first-quadrant double complex $D^{i,b}=\operatorname{Hom}_A(M^{u-b},I^i)$. Its degree-translated total complex $Q^t=\operatorname{Tot}(D)^{t+u}$ represents $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,N[0])$ in $D(A)$. Hence applying derived cohomology identifies the abutment in degree $t$ with $H^{t+u}(\operatorname{Tot}D)$, $A$-linearly.

source.place: Tag 0G1Z, remark-ext-from-filtered-complex: the K-injective Hom-complex model, specialized to a module target and realized by a signed first-quadrant total complex; resolution construction in derived.tex lemma-injective-resolutions-exist (1), total convention in homology.tex section-double-complex.

proof.text: Apply the first spectral sequence of [thm-sp-double-complex-spectral-sequences] to $D$, writing it $\widetilde E$, in $\operatorname{Mod}(A)$, an abelian category by [lem-weil-pbc-ring-modules-enough-injectives]. Its first page is $H^b_\mathrm{II}(D^{i,\bullet})$ with $d_1$ induced by $d_\mathrm{I}$, and its second page is $H^i_\mathrm{I}H^b_\mathrm{II}(D)$. By [lem-trf-injective-hom-double-cohomology] these are respectively $\operatorname{Hom}_A(H^{u-b}(M),I^i)$, with differential induced by postcomposition with $d_I$, and $\operatorname{Ext}^i_A(H^{u-b}(K),N)$. All identifications are $A$-linear. Kernels, images and quotients are in $\operatorname{Mod}(A)$; the next-page isomorphisms of [def-sp-spectral-sequence] therefore give the required kernel/image formula.

source.place: Tag 0130, lemma-ss-double-complex, first spectral sequence; Injectives Tag 0G20, remark-spectral-sequences-ext-variant.

proof.text: Set $E_s^{i,j}=\widetilde E_s^{i,j+u}$ for $s\geq2$. This translation preserves the differential bidegree $(s,1-s)$ and the next-page kernel/image formula. It gives $E_2^{i,j}=\operatorname{Ext}^i_A(H^{-j}(K),N)$, with support $i\geq0$, $j\geq-u$ on every page. By [thm-sp-double-complex-spectral-sequences], $\widetilde E_s^{i,b}$ stabilizes, and in degree $n=t+u\geq0$ the first image filtration has $F^0H^n=H^n$, $F^{n+1}H^n=0$ and $\operatorname{gr}^i_FH^n=\widetilde E_\infty^{i,n-i}$. Through step 2 this is a finite exhaustive separated filtration [def-sp-filtration] of $H^tR\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,N[0])$, whose quotients are $E_\infty^{i,t-i}$ for $0\leq i\leq t+u$, equivalently $E_\infty^{t-j,j}$ for $-u\leq j\leq t$. If $t+u<0$, the first-quadrant total complex is zero in that degree, so its cohomology, and thus the abutment, is zero. The construction imposed no condition on $A$ or its modules beyond those in the statement.
